landing.heroSubtitle: RoadSource is the central workspace for IT Road's sales, sourcing, and management teams to capture client demands, search the talent hub, and track every candidate to hire.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything sourcing needs, in one workspace.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Purpose-built for IT Road's internal flow — capture demands from sales, route them to sourcing, and track candidates with financial context all the way to placement.
landing.f1Body: Centralize client demands with engagement type, status, and assigned sourcers.
landing.f2Body: Search the internal CV database by seniority, skills, availability and engagement preference.
landing.f3Body: Move candidates through stages and keep a single source of truth per demand.
landing.f4Body: Rate cards and candidate financials so managers can validate margins fast.
landing.f5Body: Admin, manager, sales and sourcing roles enforced with row-level security.
landing.f6Body: From the moment a demand is logged to the placement — one road, no spreadsheets.
landing.workflowTitle: A clear path from request to hire.
landing.step1Body: Sales logs the client demand with role, engagement, and timeline.
landing.step2Body: Managers route demands to sourcing team members.
landing.step3Body: Sourcers search the Talent Hub and shortlist matches.
landing.step4Body: Move candidates through stages until the placement is closed.
landing.rolesSubtitle: RoadSource adapts to what each team needs to see — without compromising on data access controls.
landing.roleSourcingBody: Work assigned demands and search talent.
landing.ctaSubtitle: Sign in to RoadSource and pick up where the team left off.
